data.name: Greater Charmed Life
data.description: The mysterious avenger gains three extra uses of charmed life. As an immediate action, she can expend one use of charmed life to gain a +%1 bonus to her AC. She must choose to do this before the attack roll is made against her.|max(1,CHA)
